field_text_formatted.value: Big thanks to Oleh Vehera, who kept this module alive while my focus was elsewhere. The Drupal 9 port, then Drupal 10, the move to Drush 12, the hooks lifted into classes and the services behind them are all his. So is the status report warning above. He has commit access.
